{{NPC Infobox |image = NPC Shuhe.png |type = Open-World |nation = Huanglong |location = Jinzhou |group = |affiliation = Public Security Bureau |title = |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} '''Shuhe''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. ==Dialogue== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(During the day) :'''Shuhe:''' Permission is required for an audience with Madam Magistrate. :{{DIcon}} I must see Madam Magistrate now. It's urgent. ::'''Shuhe:''' No, you need approval or permission from [[Sanhua]] before you can see the Magistrate. ::'''Shuhe:''' Alright, fine. Walk right in, by all means! Make my... Oh, wait, you've got your papers in order? ::'''Shuhe:''' If you have the right paperwork, you're good to go. :{{DIcon}} I'm just having a walk. ::'''Shuhe:''' This is the City Hall of Jinzhou, it's not a playground. ::'''Shuhe:''' According to the Magistrate's rules, it's not against the law to hang around here. ::'''Shuhe:''' But I will keep an eye on you. ---- ;(During the evening) :'''Shuhe:''' What should be done here... :'''Shuhe:''' Hey, what are you doing here? :{{DIcon}} You don't sleep at all? :'''Shuhe:''' Always need to match your effort to the task at hand. :'''Shuhe:''' Guarding City Hall is a duty given to us by the Magistrate and Sanhua, and we take it seriously. :'''Shuhe:''' Ahem, okay, please don't interfere with the duties of personnel on duty! {{Dialogue End}} ==Trivia== *At night around 18:00, [[Yingda]] calls over [[Shuhe]] and [[Chenbi]] from their post to talk. The two will return to their post at 21:00. {{Description|Yingda: The number of applications for meetings at City Hall is on the rise.
Yingda:I'm not sure if Chenbi and Shuhe are up for this challenge...
Yingda: Chenbi, Shuhe, come here.
Chenbi: Captain...
Yingda: Anything unusual?
Shuhe: Not really.
Shuhe: But those rejected by Lady Sanhua just won't leave.
Chenbi: Maybe they really have important causes...
Chenbi: But no matter what, our first duty is to do our jobs well.
Yingda: Very well, our main goal is to maintain order in City Hall, no matter the circumstances.
Yingda: Please report any issues immediately.}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Shuhe |zhs = 树赫 |zht = 樹赫 |ja = 樹赫（ジュカク） |ko = 수혁 |es = Shuhe |fr = Shuhe |de = Shuhe }} ==Change History== {{Change History|1.0}}
